text: i am very lazy and this app has helped me a lot to actually want to get up into the morning so I can finish my routine and I can be free all day instead of stressing not knowing if I'm going to manage to get everything done in one day now it's managing what am I supposed to do with my free time this app is perfect for lazy people like me because it helps a lot so yeah if you're looking for an app that can help you with your laziness this is the one with my experience i want you to use it 💯💯💯
author: Angela Dimitrijov
